job.resolved_prompt:
### Use case(s) - what problem will this feature solve?

In some cases we want to retry connections more aggressively compared to the default behavior (e.g. for health checkers in tests in order to detect that server is up faster).

### Proposed Solution

Add tunable parameters as described in the [documentation](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/connection-backoff.md).

It can be done by extending `grpc.BackoffConfig` struct (and therefore is not a breaking change).

interaction_steps.prompt:
### Use case(s) - what problem will this feature solve?

In some cases we want to retry connections more aggressively compared to the default behavior (e.g. for health checkers in tests in order to detect that server is up faster).

### Proposed Solution

Add tunable parameters as described in the [documentation](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/connection-backoff.md).

It can be done by extending `grpc.BackoffConfig` struct (and therefore is not a breaking change).

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'PROJECT_BRIEF.md' -g 'README*' -g 'CONTRIBUTING*' | head -80 && sed -n '1,240p' backoff.go && sed -n '1,260p' internal/backoff/backoff.go && rg -n 'BackoffConfig|Default.*Backoff|backoff' --glob '*.go' | head -150"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '230,280p' dialoptions.go && sed -n '220,248p' clientconn.go && sed -n '930,980p' clientconn.go && sed -n '800,875p' clientconn_test.go && rg -n 'MinConnectTimeout|min.*connect|backoff.Exponential' --glob '*.go'"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '40,62p' clientconn.go && sed -n '500,550p' dialoptions.go && rg -n 'const \\(|minConnectTimeout|connectDeadline' clientconn.go dialoptions.go"

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w backoff.go internal/backoff/backoff.go dialoptions.go clientconn.go clientconn_test.go && git diff --check && git diff -- backoff.go internal/backoff/backoff.go dialoptions.go clientconn.go clientconn_test.go'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- backoff.go internal/backoff/backoff.go dialoptions.go clientconn.go clientconn_test.go'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rm -f .scratch/go/tmp/xcrun_db && rmdir .scratch/go/tmp .scratch/go .scratch 2>/dev/null || true; git diff --check && git status --short --untracked-files=all'
